# ML-DSA signature verification with non-empty FIPS 204 context strings.
#
# Derived from the ML-DSA reference implementation "hedged pure" KAT vendored by
# AWS-LC at:
#   https://github.com/aws/aws-lc/blob/main/crypto/fipsmodule/ml_dsa/kat/MLDSA_44_hedged_pure.txt
#
# In that file `sm` is the signed message, i.e. the signature followed by the
# message, and `smlen` is its total length. SIGNATURE below is the leading
# 2420 bytes of `sm` (ML-DSA-44 signature length); MESSAGE is `msg` and CONTEXT
# is `ctx`. Only the first few records are reproduced here.
